field.name: TXQEN
field.description: Transmit Queue Enable This field is used to enable/disable the transmit queue 0.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Not enabled

enumeratedValue.name: EN_IF_AV
enumeratedValue.description: Enable in AV mode (Reserved in non-AV)

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled

field.name: TTC
field.description: Transmit Threshold Control These bits control the threshold level of the MTL Tx Queue.

field.name: TQS
field.description: Transmit Queue Size This field indicates the size of the allocated Transmit queues in blocks of 256 bytes.

field.name: UFFRMCNT
field.description: Underflow Packet Counter This field indicates the number of packets aborted by the controller because of Tx Queue Underflow.

field.name: UFCNTOVF
field.description: Overflow Bit for Underflow Packet Counter This bit is set every time the Tx queue Underflow Packet Counter field overflows, that is, it has crossed the maximum count.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Overflow not detected for Underflow Packet Counter

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Overflow detected for Underflow Packet Counter

field.name: TXQPAUSED
field.description: Transmit Queue in Pause When this bit is high and the Rx flow control is enabled, it indicates that the Tx Queue is in the Pause condition (in the full-duplex only mode) because of the following: - Reception of the PFC packet for the priorities assigned to the Tx Queue when PFC is enabled - Reception of 802.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Queue in Pause status is not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Queue in Pause status is detected

field.name: TRCSTS
field.description: MTL Tx Queue Read Controller Status This field indicates the state of the Tx Queue Read Controller:

enumeratedValue.name: IDLE
enumeratedValue.description: Idle state

enumeratedValue.name: READ
enumeratedValue.description: Read state (transferring data to the MAC transmitter)

enumeratedValue.name: WAIT
enumeratedValue.description: Waiting for pending Tx Status from the MAC transmitter

enumeratedValue.name: FLUSH
enumeratedValue.description: Flushing the Tx queue because of the Packet Abort request from the MAC

field.name: TWCSTS
field.description: MTL Tx Queue Write Controller Status When high, this bit indicates that the MTL Tx Queue Write Controller is active, and it is transferring the data to the Tx Queue.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: MTL Tx Queue Write Controller status is not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: MTL Tx Queue Write Controller status is detected

field.name: TXQSTS
field.description: MTL Tx Queue Not Empty Status When this bit is high, it indicates that the MTL Tx Queue is not empty and some data is left for transmission.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: MTL Tx Queue Not Empty status is not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: MTL Tx Queue Not Empty status is detected

field.name: TXSTSFSTS
field.description: MTL Tx Status FIFO Full Status When high, this bit indicates that the MTL Tx Status FIFO is full.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: MTL Tx Status FIFO Full status is not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: MTL Tx Status FIFO Full status is detected

field.name: PTXQ
field.description: Number of Packets in the Transmit Queue This field indicates the current number of packets in the Tx Queue.

field.name: STXSTSF
field.description: Number of Status Words in Tx Status FIFO of Queue This field indicates the current number of status in the Tx Status FIFO of this queue.

field.name: AVALG
field.description: AV Algorithm When Queue 1 is programmed for AV, this field configures the scheduling algorithm for this queue: This bit when set, indicates credit based shaper algorithm (CBS) is selected for Queue 1 traffic.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: CBS Algorithm is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: CBS Algorithm is enabled

field.name: CC
field.description: Credit Control When this bit is set, the accumulated credit parameter in the credit-based shaper algorithm logic is not reset to zero when there is positive credit and no packet to transmit in Channel 1.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Credit Control is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Credit Control is enabled

enumeratedValue.name: bf_1_SLOT
enumeratedValue.description: 1 slot

enumeratedValue.name: bf_2_SLOT
enumeratedValue.description: 2 slots

enumeratedValue.name: bf_4_SLOT
enumeratedValue.description: 4 slots

enumeratedValue.name: bf_8_SLOT
enumeratedValue.description: 8 slots

enumeratedValue.name: bf_16_SLOT
enumeratedValue.description: 16 slots

field.name: ABS
field.description: Average Bits per Slot This field contains the average transmitted bits per slot.

field.name: ISCQW
field.description: idleSlopeCredit, Quantum or Weights - idleSlopeCredit When AV feature is enabled, this field contains the idleSlopeCredit value required for the credit-based shaper algorithm for Queue 1.

field.name: SSC
field.description: sendSlopeCredit Value When AV operation is enabled, this field contains the sendSlopeCredit value required for credit-based shaper algorithm for Queue 1.

field.name: HC
field.description: hiCredit Value When the AV feature is enabled, this field contains the hiCredit value required for the credit-based shaper algorithm.

field.name: LC
field.description: loCredit Value When AV operation is enabled, this field contains the loCredit value required for the credit-based shaper algorithm.

field.name: TXUNFIS
field.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Status This bit indicates that the Transmit Queue had an underflow while transmitting the packet.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Status detected

field.name: ABPSIS
field.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt Status When set, this bit indicates that the MAC has updated the ABS value.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt Status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt Status detected

field.name: TXUIE
field.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Enable When this bit is set, the Transmit Queue Underflow interrupt is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Status is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Status is enabled

field.name: ABPSIE
field.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt Enable When this bit is set, the MAC asserts the sbd_intr_o or mci_intr_o interrupt when the average bits per slot status is updated.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt is enabled

field.name: RXOVFIS
field.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt Status This bit indicates that the Receive Queue had an overflow while receiving the packet.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt Status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt Status detected

field.name: RXOIE
field.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt Enable When this bit is set, the Receive Queue Overflow interrupt is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt is enabled

field.name: RTC
field.description: Receive Queue Threshold Control These bits control the threshold level of the MTL Rx queue (in bytes): The received packet is transferred to the application or DMA when the packet size within the MTL Rx queue is larger than the threshold.

field.name: FUP
field.description: Forward Undersized Good Packets When this bit is set, the Rx queue forwards the undersized good packets (packets with no error and length less than 64 bytes), including pad-bytes and CRC.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Forward Undersized Good Packets is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Forward Undersized Good Packets is enabled

field.name: FEP
field.description: Forward Error Packets When this bit is reset, the Rx queue drops packets with error status (CRC error, GMII_ER, watchdog timeout, or overflow).

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Forward Error Packets is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Forward Error Packets is enabled

field.name: RSF
field.description: Receive Queue Store and Forward When this bit is set, the DWC_ether_qos reads a packet from the Rx queue only after the complete packet has been written to it, ignoring the RTC field of this register.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Store and Forward is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Store and Forward is enabled

field.name: DIS_TCP_EF
field.description: Disable Dropping of TCP/IP Checksum Error Packets When this bit is set, the MAC does not drop the packets which only have the errors detected by the Receive Checksum Offload engine.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Dropping of TCP/IP Checksum Error Packets is enabled

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Dropping of TCP/IP Checksum Error Packets is disabled

field.name: EHFC
field.description: Enable Hardware Flow Control When this bit is set, the flow control signal operation, based on the fill-level of Rx queue, is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware Flow Control is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware Flow Control is enabled

field.name: RFA
field.description: Threshold for Activating Flow Control (in half-duplex and full-duplex These bits control the threshold (fill-level of Rx queue) at which the flow control is activated: For more information on encoding for this field, see RFD.

field.name: RFD
field.description: Threshold for Deactivating Flow Control (in half-duplex and full-duplex modes) These bits control the threshold (fill-level of Rx queue) at which the flow control is de-asserted after activation: - 0: Full minus 1 KB, that is, FULL 1 KB - 1: Full minus 1.

field.name: RQS
field.description: Receive Queue Size This field indicates the size of the allocated Receive queues in blocks of 256 bytes.

register.name: MTL_RXQ1_MISSED_PACKET_OVERFLOW_CNT
register.description: Queue 1 Missed Packet and Overflow Counter

field.name: OVFPKTCNT
field.description: Overflow Packet Counter This field indicates the number of packets discarded by the DWC_ether_qos because of Receive queue overflow.

field.name: OVFCNTOVF
field.description: Overflow Counter Overflow Bit When set, this bit indicates that the Rx Queue Overflow Packet Counter field crossed the maximum limit.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Overflow Counter overflow not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Overflow Counter overflow detected

field.name: MISPKTCNT
field.description: Missed Packet Counter This field indicates the number of packets missed by the DWC_ether_qos because the application asserted ari_pkt_flush_i[] for this queue.

field.name: MISCNTOVF
field.description: Missed Packet Counter Overflow Bit When set, this bit indicates that the Rx Queue Missed Packet Counter crossed the maximum limit.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Missed Packet Counter overflow not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Missed Packet Counter overflow detected

field.name: RWCSTS

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: MTL Rx Queue Write Controller Active Status detected

field.name: RRCSTS
field.description: MTL Rx Queue Read Controller State This field gives the state of the Rx queue Read controller:

enumeratedValue.name: IDLE
enumeratedValue.description: Idle state

enumeratedValue.name: READ_DATA
enumeratedValue.description: Reading packet data

enumeratedValue.name: READ_STS
enumeratedValue.description: Reading packet status (or timestamp)

enumeratedValue.name: FLUSH
enumeratedValue.description: Flushing the packet data and status

field.name: RXQSTS
field.description: MTL Rx Queue Fill-Level Status This field gives the status of the fill-level of the Rx Queue:

enumeratedValue.name: EMPTY
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Queue empty

enumeratedValue.name: BLW_THR
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Queue fill-level below flow-control deactivate threshold

enumeratedValue.name: ABV_THR
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Queue fill-level above flow-control activate threshold

enumeratedValue.name: FULL
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Queue full

field.name: PRXQ
field.description: Number of Packets in Receive Queue This field indicates the current number of packets in the Rx Queue.

field.name: RXQ_WEGT
field.description: Receive Queue Weight This field indicates the weight assigned to the Rx Queue 1.

field.name: RXQ_FRM_ARBIT
field.description: Receive Queue Packet Arbitration When this bit is set, the DWC_ether_qos drives the packet data to the ARI interface such that the entire packet data of currently-selected queue is transmitted before switching to other queue.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Packet Arbitration is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Packet Arbitration is enabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Flush Transmit Queue is enabled

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Packet Arbitration is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Packet Arbitration is enabled

field.name: FTQ
field.description: Flush Transmit Queue When this bit is set, the Tx queue controller logic is reset to its default values.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Flush Transmit Queue is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Flush Transmit Queue is enabled

field.name: TSF
field.description: Transmit Store and Forward When this bit is set, the transmission starts when a full packet resides in the MTL Tx queue.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Store and Forward is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Store and Forward is enabled

field.name: TXQEN
field.description: Transmit Queue Enable This field is used to enable/disable the transmit queue 0.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Not enabled

enumeratedValue.name: EN_IF_AV
enumeratedValue.description: Enable in AV mode (Reserved in non-AV)

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled

field.name: TTC
field.description: Transmit Threshold Control These bits control the threshold level of the MTL Tx Queue.

field.name: TQS
field.description: Transmit Queue Size This field indicates the size of the allocated Transmit queues in blocks of 256 bytes.

field.name: UFFRMCNT
field.description: Underflow Packet Counter This field indicates the number of packets aborted by the controller because of Tx Queue Underflow.

field.name: UFCNTOVF
field.description: Overflow Bit for Underflow Packet Counter This bit is set every time the Tx queue Underflow Packet Counter field overflows, that is, it has crossed the maximum count.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Overflow not detected for Underflow Packet Counter

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Overflow detected for Underflow Packet Counter

field.name: TXQPAUSED
field.description: Transmit Queue in Pause When this bit is high and the Rx flow control is enabled, it indicates that the Tx Queue is in the Pause condition (in the full-duplex only mode) because of the following: - Reception of the PFC packet for the priorities assigned to the Tx Queue when PFC is enabled - Reception of 802.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Queue in Pause status is not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Queue in Pause status is detected

field.name: TRCSTS
field.description: MTL Tx Queue Read Controller Status This field indicates the state of the Tx Queue Read Controller:

enumeratedValue.name: IDLE
enumeratedValue.description: Idle state

enumeratedValue.name: READ
enumeratedValue.description: Read state (transferring data to the MAC transmitter)

enumeratedValue.name: WAIT
enumeratedValue.description: Waiting for pending Tx Status from the MAC transmitter

enumeratedValue.name: FLUSH
enumeratedValue.description: Flushing the Tx queue because of the Packet Abort request from the MAC

field.name: TWCSTS
field.description: MTL Tx Queue Write Controller Status When high, this bit indicates that the MTL Tx Queue Write Controller is active, and it is transferring the data to the Tx Queue.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: MTL Tx Queue Write Controller status is not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: MTL Tx Queue Write Controller status is detected

field.name: TXQSTS
field.description: MTL Tx Queue Not Empty Status When this bit is high, it indicates that the MTL Tx Queue is not empty and some data is left for transmission.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: MTL Tx Queue Not Empty status is not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: MTL Tx Queue Not Empty status is detected

field.name: TXSTSFSTS
field.description: MTL Tx Status FIFO Full Status When high, this bit indicates that the MTL Tx Status FIFO is full.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: MTL Tx Status FIFO Full status is not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: MTL Tx Status FIFO Full status is detected

field.name: PTXQ
field.description: Number of Packets in the Transmit Queue This field indicates the current number of packets in the Tx Queue.

field.name: STXSTSF
field.description: Number of Status Words in Tx Status FIFO of Queue This field indicates the current number of status in the Tx Status FIFO of this queue.

field.name: AVALG
field.description: AV Algorithm When Queue 3 is programmed for AV, this field configures the scheduling algorithm for this queue: This bit when set, indicates credit based shaper algorithm (CBS) is selected for Queue 3 traffic.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: CBS Algorithm is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: CBS Algorithm is enabled

field.name: CC
field.description: Credit Control When this bit is set, the accumulated credit parameter in the credit-based shaper algorithm logic is not reset to zero when there is positive credit and no packet to transmit in Channel 3.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Credit Control is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Credit Control is enabled

enumeratedValue.name: bf_1_SLOT
enumeratedValue.description: 1 slot

enumeratedValue.name: bf_2_SLOT
enumeratedValue.description: 2 slots

enumeratedValue.name: bf_4_SLOT
enumeratedValue.description: 4 slots

enumeratedValue.name: bf_8_SLOT
enumeratedValue.description: 8 slots

enumeratedValue.name: bf_16_SLOT
enumeratedValue.description: 16 slots

field.name: ABS
field.description: Average Bits per Slot This field contains the average transmitted bits per slot.

field.name: ISCQW
field.description: idleSlopeCredit, Quantum or Weights - idleSlopeCredit When AV feature is enabled, this field contains the idleSlopeCredit value required for the credit-based shaper algorithm for Queue 3.

field.name: SSC
field.description: sendSlopeCredit Value When AV operation is enabled, this field contains the sendSlopeCredit value required for credit-based shaper algorithm for Queue 3.

field.name: HC
field.description: hiCredit Value When the AV feature is enabled, this field contains the hiCredit value required for the credit-based shaper algorithm.

field.name: LC
field.description: loCredit Value When AV operation is enabled, this field contains the loCredit value required for the credit-based shaper algorithm.

field.name: TXUNFIS
field.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Status This bit indicates that the Transmit Queue had an underflow while transmitting the packet.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Status detected

field.name: ABPSIS
field.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt Status When set, this bit indicates that the MAC has updated the ABS value.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt Status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt Status detected

field.name: TXUIE
field.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Enable When this bit is set, the Transmit Queue Underflow interrupt is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Status is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Status is enabled

field.name: ABPSIE
field.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt Enable When this bit is set, the MAC asserts the sbd_intr_o or mci_intr_o interrupt when the average bits per slot status is updated.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt is enabled

field.name: RXOVFIS
field.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt Status This bit indicates that the Receive Queue had an overflow while receiving the packet.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt Status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt Status detected

field.name: RXOIE
field.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt Enable When this bit is set, the Receive Queue Overflow interrupt is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt is enabled

field.name: RTC
field.description: Receive Queue Threshold Control These bits control the threshold level of the MTL Rx queue (in bytes): The received packet is transferred to the application or DMA when the packet size within the MTL Rx queue is larger than the threshold.

field.name: FUP
field.description: Forward Undersized Good Packets When this bit is set, the Rx queue forwards the undersized good packets (packets with no error and length less than 64 bytes), including pad-bytes and CRC.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Forward Undersized Good Packets is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Forward Undersized Good Packets is enabled

field.name: FEP
field.description: Forward Error Packets When this bit is reset, the Rx queue drops packets with error status (CRC error, GMII_ER, watchdog timeout, or overflow).

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Forward Error Packets is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Forward Error Packets is enabled

field.name: RSF
field.description: Receive Queue Store and Forward When this bit is set, the DWC_ether_qos reads a packet from the Rx queue only after the complete packet has been written to it, ignoring the RTC field of this register.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Store and Forward is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Store and Forward is enabled

field.name: DIS_TCP_EF
field.description: Disable Dropping of TCP/IP Checksum Error Packets When this bit is set, the MAC does not drop the packets which only have the errors detected by the Receive Checksum Offload engine.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Dropping of TCP/IP Checksum Error Packets is enabled

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Dropping of TCP/IP Checksum Error Packets is disabled

field.name: EHFC
field.description: Enable Hardware Flow Control When this bit is set, the flow control signal operation, based on the fill-level of Rx queue, is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware Flow Control is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware Flow Control is enabled

field.name: RFA
field.description: Threshold for Activating Flow Control (in half-duplex and full-duplex These bits control the threshold (fill-level of Rx queue) at which the flow control is activated: For more information on encoding for this field, see RFD.

field.name: RFD
field.description: Threshold for Deactivating Flow Control (in half-duplex and full-duplex modes) These bits control the threshold (fill-level of Rx queue) at which the flow control is de-asserted after activation: - 0: Full minus 1 KB, that is, FULL 1 KB - 1: Full minus 1.

field.name: RQS
field.description: Receive Queue Size This field indicates the size of the allocated Receive queues in blocks of 256 bytes.

register.name: MTL_RXQ3_MISSED_PACKET_OVERFLOW_CNT
register.description: Queue 3 Missed Packet and Overflow Counter

field.name: OVFPKTCNT
field.description: Overflow Packet Counter This field indicates the number of packets discarded by the DWC_ether_qos because of Receive queue overflow.

field.description: Overflow Counter Overflow Bit When set, this bit indicates that the Rx Queue Overflow Packet Counter field crossed the maximum limit.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Overflow Counter overflow not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Overflow Counter overflow detected

field.name: MISPKTCNT

field.name: MISCNTOVF
field.description: Missed Packet Counter Overflow Bit When set, this bit indicates that the Rx Queue Missed Packet Counter crossed the maximum limit.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Missed Packet Counter overflow not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Missed Packet Counter overflow detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: MTL Rx Queue Write Controller Active Status detected

enumeratedValue.name: READ_STS

enumeratedValue.name: FLUSH

field.name: RXQSTS
field.description: MTL Rx Queue Fill-Level Status This field gives the status of the fill-level of the Rx Queue:

enumeratedValue.name: EMPTY
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Queue empty

enumeratedValue.name: BLW_THR
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Queue fill-level below flow-control deactivate threshold

enumeratedValue.name: ABV_THR
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Queue fill-level above flow-control activate threshold

enumeratedValue.name: FULL
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Queue full

field.name: PRXQ
field.description: Number of Packets in Receive Queue This field indicates the current number of packets in the Rx Queue.

field.name: RXQ_WEGT
field.description: Receive Queue Weight This field indicates the weight assigned to the Rx Queue 4.

field.name: RXQ_FRM_ARBIT
field.description: Receive Queue Packet Arbitration When this bit is set, the DWC_ether_qos drives the packet data to the ARI interface such that the entire packet data of currently-selected queue is transmitted before switching to other queue.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Packet Arbitration is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Packet Arbitration is enabled

field.name: SWR
field.description: Software Reset When this bit is set, the MAC and the DMA controller reset the logic and all internal registers of the DMA, MTL, and MAC.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Software Reset is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Software Reset is enabled

field.name: DSPW
field.description: Descriptor Posted Write When this bit is set to 0, the descriptor writes are always non-posted.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Descriptor Posted Write is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Descriptor Posted Write is enabled

field.name: INTM
field.description: Interrupt Mode This field defines the interrupt mode of DWC_ether_qos.

enumeratedValue.name: MODE0
enumeratedValue.description: See above description

enumeratedValue.name: MODE1
enumeratedValue.description: See above description

enumeratedValue.name: MODE2
enumeratedValue.description: See above description

field.name: FB
field.description: Fixed Burst Length When this bit is set to 1, the EQOS-AXI master initiates burst transfers of specified lengths as given below.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Fixed Burst Length is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Fixed Burst Length is enabled

field.name: BLEN4
field.description: AXI Burst Length 4 When this bit is set to 1 or the FB bit is set to 0, the EQOS-AXI master can select a burst length of 4 on the AXI interface.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: No effect

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: AXI Burst Length 4

field.name: BLEN8
field.description: AXI Burst Length 8 When this bit is set to 1 or the FB bit is set to 0, the EQOS-AXI master can select a burst length of 8 on the AXI interface.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: No effect

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: AXI Burst Length 8

field.name: BLEN16
field.description: AXI Burst Length 16 When this bit is set to 1 or the FB bit is set to 0, the EQOS-AXI master can select a burst length of 16 on the AXI interface.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: No effect

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: AXI Burst Length 16

field.name: AALE
field.description: Automatic AXI LPI enable When set to 1, enables the AXI master to enter into LPI state when there is no activity in the DWC_ether_qos for number of system clock cycles programmed in the LPIEI field of DMA_AXI_LPI_ENTRY_INTERVAL register.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Automatic AXI LPI is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Automatic AXI LPI is enabled

field.name: AAL
field.description: Address-Aligned Beats When this bit is set to 1, the EQOS-AXI or EQOS-AHB master performs address-aligned burst transfers on Read and Write channels.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Address-Aligned Beats is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Address-Aligned Beats is enabled

field.name: ONEKBBE
field.description: 1 KB Boundary Crossing Enable for the EQOS-AXI Master When set, the burst transfers performed by the EQOS-AXI master do not cross 1 KB boundary.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: 1 KB Boundary Crossing for the EQOS-AXI Master Beats is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: 1 KB Boundary Crossing for the EQOS-AXI Master Beats is enabled

field.name: RD_OSR_LMT
field.description: AXI Maximum Read Outstanding Request Limit This value limits the maximum outstanding request on the AXI read interface.

field.name: WR_OSR_LMT
field.description: AXI Maximum Write Outstanding Request Limit This value limits the maximum outstanding request on the AXI write interface.

field.name: LPI_XIT_PKT

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Unlock on Magic Packet or Remote Wake-Up Packet is enabled

field.name: EN_LPI

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Low Power Interface (LPI) is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Low Power Interface (LPI) is enabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: 8xPBL mode is enabled

enumeratedValue.name: START

register.name: DMA_CH0_SLOT_FUNCTION_CONTROL_STATUS
register.description: Channel 0 Slot Function Control and Status

field.name: ESC
field.description: Enable Slot Comparison When set, this bit enables the checking of the slot numbers programmed in the Tx descriptor with the current reference given in the RSN field.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Slot Comparison is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Slot Comparison is enabled

field.name: ASC
field.description: Advance Slot Check When set, this bit enables the DMA to fetch the data from the buffer when the slot number (SLOTNUM) programmed in the Tx descriptor is - equal to the reference slot number given in the RSN field or - ahead of the reference slot number by up to two slots This bit is applicable only when the ESC bit is set.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Advance Slot Check is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Advance Slot Check is enabled

field.name: SIV
field.description: Slot Interval Value This field controls the period of the slot interval in which the TxDMA fetches the scheduled packets.

field.name: RSN
field.description: Reference Slot Number This field gives the current value of the reference slot number in the DMA.

field.name: CURTDESAPTR
field.description: Application Transmit Descriptor Address Pointer The DMA updates this pointer during Tx operation.

field.name: CURRDESAPTR
field.description: Application Receive Descriptor Address Pointer The DMA updates this pointer during Rx operation.

register.name: DMA_CH0_CURRENT_APP_TXBUFFER
register.description: Channel 0 Current Application Transmit Buffer Address

field.name: CURTBUFAPTR
field.description: Application Transmit Buffer Address Pointer The DMA updates this pointer during Tx operation.

register.name: DMA_CH0_CURRENT_APP_RXBUFFER
register.description: Channel 0 Current Application Receive Buffer Address

field.name: CURRBUFAPTR
field.description: Application Receive Buffer Address Pointer The DMA updates this pointer during Rx operation.

field.name: TI
field.description: Transmit Interrupt This bit indicates that the packet transmission is complete.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Interrupt status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Interrupt status detected

field.name: TPS
field.description: Transmit Process Stopped This bit is set when the transmission is stopped.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Process Stopped status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Process Stopped status detected

field.name: TBU
field.description: Transmit Buffer Unavailable This bit indicates that the application owns the next descriptor in the Transmit list, and the DMA cannot acquire it.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Buffer Unavailable status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Buffer Unavailable status detected

field.name: RI
field.description: Receive Interrupt This bit indicates that the packet reception is complete.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Interrupt status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Interrupt status detected

field.name: RBU
field.description: Receive Buffer Unavailable This bit indicates that the application owns the next descriptor in the Receive list, and the DMA cannot acquire it.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Buffer Unavailable status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Buffer Unavailable status detected

field.name: RPS
field.description: Receive Process Stopped This bit is asserted when the Rx process enters the Stopped state.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Process Stopped status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Process Stopped status detected

field.name: RWT
field.description: Receive Watchdog Timeout This bit is asserted when a packet with length greater than 2,048 bytes (10,240 bytes when Jumbo Packet mode is enabled) is received.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Watchdog Timeout status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Watchdog Timeout status detected

field.name: ETI
field.description: Early Transmit Interrupt This bit when set indicates that the TxDMA has completed the transfer of packet data to the MTL TXFIFO memory.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Early Transmit Interrupt status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Early Transmit Interrupt status detected

field.name: ERI
field.description: Early Receive Interrupt This bit when set indicates that the RxDMA has completed the transfer of packet data to the memory.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Early Receive Interrupt status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Early Receive Interrupt status detected

field.name: FBE
field.description: Fatal Bus Error This bit indicates that a bus error occurred (as described in the EB field).

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Fatal Bus Error status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Fatal Bus Error status detected

field.name: CDE
field.description: Context Descriptor Error This bit indicates that the DMA Tx/Rx engine received a descriptor error, which indicates invalid context in the middle of packet flow (intermediate descriptor) or all ones descriptor in Tx case and on Rx side it indicates DMA has read a descriptor with either of the buffer address as ones which is considered to be invalid.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Context Descriptor Error status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Context Descriptor Error status detected

field.name: AIS
field.description: Abnormal Interrupt Summary Abnormal Interrupt Summary bit value is the logical OR of the following when the corresponding interrupt bits are enabled in the INTERRUPT_ENABLE register: - Bit 1: Transmit Process Stopped - Bit 7: Receive Buffer Unavailable - Bit 8: Receive Process Stopped - Bit 10: Early Transmit Interrupt - Bit 12: Fatal Bus Error - Bit 13: Context Descriptor Error Only unmasked bits affect the Abnormal Interrupt Summary bit.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Abnormal Interrupt Summary status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Abnormal Interrupt Summary status detected

field.name: NIS
field.description: Normal Interrupt Summary Normal Interrupt Summary bit value is the logical OR of the following bits when the corresponding interrupt bits are enabled in the DMA_CH0_INTERRUPT_ENABLE register: - Bit 0: Transmit Interrupt - Bit 2: Transmit Buffer Unavailable - Bit 6: Receive Interrupt - Bit 11: Early Receive Interrupt Only unmasked bits (interrupts for which interrupt enable is set in INTERRUPT_ENABLE register) affect the Normal Interrupt Summary bit.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Normal Interrupt Summary status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Normal Interrupt Summary status detected

field.name: TEB
field.description: Tx DMA Error Bits This field indicates the type of error that caused a Bus Error.

field.name: REB
field.description: Rx DMA Error Bits This field indicates the type of error that caused a Bus Error.

field.name: MFC
field.description: Dropped Packet Counters This counter indicates the number of packet counters that are dropped by the DMA either because of bus error or because of programming RPF field in DMA_CH0_RX_CONTROL register.

field.name: MFCO
field.description: Overflow status of the MFC Counter When this bit is set then the MFC counter does not get incremented further.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Miss Frame Counter overflow not occurred

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Miss Frame Counter overflow occurred

field.name: RXPAC
field.description: Rx Parser Accept Counter This 31-bit counter is implemented whenever a Rx Parser Accept a packet due to AF =1.

field.name: RXPACOF
field.description: Rx Parser Accept Counter Overflow Bit When set, this bit indicates that the RXPAC Counter field crossed the maximum limit.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Parser Accept Counter overflow not occurred

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Parser Accept Counter overflow occurred

field.name: PBLx8
field.description: 8xPBL mode When this bit is set, the PBL value programmed in Bits[21:16] in TX_CONTROL and Bits[21:16] in DMA_CH1_RX_CONTROL is multiplied by eight times.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: 8xPBL mode is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: 8xPBL mode is enabled

field.name: DSL
field.description: Descriptor Skip Length This bit specifies the Word, Dword, or Lword number (depending on the 32-bit, 64-bit, or 128-bit bus) to skip between two unchained descriptors.

field.name: ST
field.description: Start or Stop Transmission Command When this bit is set, transmission is placed in the Running state.

enumeratedValue.name: STOP
enumeratedValue.description: Stop Transmission Command

enumeratedValue.name: START
enumeratedValue.description: Start Transmission Command

field.name: OSF
field.description: Operate on Second Packet When this bit is set, it instructs the DMA to process the second packet of the Transmit data even before the status for the first packet is obtained.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Operate on Second Packet disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Operate on Second Packet enabled

field.name: IPBL
field.description: Ignore PBL Requirement When this bit is set, the DMA does not check for PBL number of locations in the MTL before initiating a transfer.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Ignore PBL Requirement is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Ignore PBL Requirement is enabled

field.name: TxPBL
field.description: Transmit Programmable Burst Length These bits indicate the maximum number of beats to be transferred in one DMA block data transfer.

field.name: EDSE
field.description: Enhanced Descriptor Enable When this bit is set, the corresponding channel uses Enhanced Descriptors that are 32 Bytes for both Normal and Context Descriptors.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Enhanced Descriptor is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Enhanced Descriptor is enabled

field.name: SR
field.description: Start or Stop Receive When this bit is set, the DMA tries to acquire the descriptor from the Receive list and processes the incoming packets.

enumeratedValue.name: STOP
enumeratedValue.description: Stop Receive

enumeratedValue.name: START
enumeratedValue.description: Start Receive

field.name: RBSZ_x_0
field.description: Receive Buffer size Low RBSZ[13:0] is split into two fields RBSZ_13_y and RBSZ_x_0.

field.name: RBSZ_13_y
field.description: Receive Buffer size High RBSZ[13:0] is split into two fields higher RBSZ_13_y and lower RBSZ_x_0.

field.name: RxPBL
field.description: Receive Programmable Burst Length These bits indicate the maximum number of beats to be transferred in one DMA block data transfer.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Packet Flush is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Packet Flush is enabled

field.name: TDESLA
field.description: Start of Transmit List This field contains the base address of the first descriptor in the Transmit descriptor list.

field.name: RDESLA
field.description: Start of Receive List This field contains the base address of the first descriptor in the Rx Descriptor list.

field.name: TDTP

field.name: RDTP

field.name: RDRL
field.description: Receive Descriptor Ring Length This register sets the maximum number of Rx descriptors in the circular descriptor ring.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Context Descriptor Error status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Context Descriptor Error status detected

field.name: AIS
field.description: Abnormal Interrupt Summary Abnormal Interrupt Summary bit value is the logical OR of the following when the corresponding interrupt bits are enabled in the DMA_CH2_INTERRUPT_ENABLE register: - Bit 1: Transmit Process Stopped - Bit 7: Receive Buffer Unavailable - Bit 8: Receive Process Stopped - Bit 10: Early Transmit Interrupt - Bit 12: Fatal Bus Error - Bit 13: Context Descriptor Error Only unmasked bits affect the Abnormal Interrupt Summary bit.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Abnormal Interrupt Summary status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Abnormal Interrupt Summary status detected

field.name: NIS
field.description: Normal Interrupt Summary Normal Interrupt Summary bit value is the logical OR of the following bits when the corresponding interrupt bits are enabled in the INTERRUPT_ENABLE register: - Bit 0: Transmit Interrupt - Bit 2: Transmit Buffer Unavailable - Bit 6: Receive Interrupt - Bit 11: Early Receive Interrupt Only unmasked bits (interrupts for which interrupt enable is set in DMA_CH2_INTERRUPT_ENABLE register) affect the Normal Interrupt Summary bit.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Normal Interrupt Summary status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Normal Interrupt Summary status detected

field.name: TEB
field.description: Tx DMA Error Bits This field indicates the type of error that caused a Bus Error.

field.name: REB
field.description: Rx DMA Error Bits This field indicates the type of error that caused a Bus Error.

field.name: MFC
field.description: Dropped Packet Counters This counter indicates the number of packet counters that are dropped by the DMA either because of bus error or because of programming RPF field in DMA_CH2_RX_CONTROL register.

field.name: MFCO
field.description: Overflow status of the MFC Counter When this bit is set then the MFC counter does not get incremented further.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Miss Frame Counter overflow not occurred

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Miss Frame Counter overflow occurred

field.name: RXPAC
field.description: Rx Parser Accept Counter This 31-bit counter is implemented whenever a Rx Parser Accept a packet due to AF =1.

field.name: RXPACOF
field.description: Rx Parser Accept Counter Overflow Bit When set, this bit indicates that the RXPAC Counter field crossed the maximum limit.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Parser Accept Counter overflow not occurred

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Parser Accept Counter overflow occurred

register.name: DMA_CH4_SLOT_FUNCTION_CONTROL_STATUS
register.description: Channel 4 Slot Function Control and Status

field.name: ESC
field.description: Enable Slot Comparison When set, this bit enables the checking of the slot numbers programmed in the Tx descriptor with the current reference given in the RSN field.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Slot Comparison is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Slot Comparison is enabled

field.name: ASC
field.description: Advance Slot Check When set, this bit enables the DMA to fetch the data from the buffer when the slot number (SLOTNUM) programmed in the Tx descriptor is - equal to the reference slot number given in the RSN field or - ahead of the reference slot number by up to two slots This bit is applicable only when the ESC bit is set.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Advance Slot Check is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Advance Slot Check is enabled

field.name: SIV
field.description: Slot Interval Value This field controls the period of the slot interval in which the TxDMA fetches the scheduled packets.

field.name: RSN

field.name: CURRDESAPTR

enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Interrupt status detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Process Stopped status detected

enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Buffer Unavailable status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Buffer Unavailable status detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Early Receive Interrupt status detected

enumeratedValue.description: Context Descriptor Error status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Context Descriptor Error status detected

enumeratedValue.description: Abnormal Interrupt Summary status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Abnormal Interrupt Summary status detected

field.name: NIS

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Normal Interrupt Summary status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Normal Interrupt Summary status detected

enumeratedValue.description: Pause frames are forwarded to the user application.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: The CRC field of received frames is transmitted to the user application.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The CRC field is stripped from the frame.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: MAC control frames with any opcode other than 0x0001 (pause frame) are accepted and forwarded to the client interface.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: MAC control frames with any opcode other than 0x0001 (pause frame) are silently discarded.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: The payload length check is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The core checks the frame's payload length with the frame length/type field. Errors are indicated in the EIR[PLR] field.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The MAC stops transmission of data frames after the current transmission is complete.

enumeratedValue.name: VAL_MAC
enumeratedValue.description: Node MAC address programmed on PADDR1/2 registers.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: The source MAC address is not modified by the MAC.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The MAC overwrites the source MAC address with the programmed MAC address according to ADDSEL.

field.name: CRCFWD

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The transmitter does not append any CRC to transmitted frames, as it is expecting a frame with CRC from the application.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: Indicates to the transmit data FIFO that the written frames contain two additional octets before the frame data. This means the actual frame begins at bit 16 of the first word written into the FIFO. This function allows putting the frame payload on a 32-bit boundary in memory, as the 14-byte Ethernet header is extended to a 16-byte header.

field.name: IPCHK
field.description: Enables insertion of IP header checksum.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Checksum is not inserted.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: If an IP frame is transmitted, the checksum is inserted automatically. The IP header checksum field must be cleared. If a non-IP frame is transmitted the frame is not modified.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Checksum not inserted.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: If an IP frame with a known protocol is transmitted, the checksum is inserted automatically into the frame. The checksum field must be cleared. The other frames are not modified.

field.name: PADREM
field.description: Enable Padding Removal For Short IP Frames

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Padding not removed.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: Any bytes following the IP payload section of the frame are removed from the frame.

field.name: IPDIS
field.description: Enable Discard Of Frames With Wrong IPv4 Header Checksum

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Frames with wrong IPv4 header checksum are not discarded.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: If an IPv4 frame is received with a mismatching header checksum, the frame is discarded. IPv6 has no header checksum and is not affected by this setting. Discarding is only available when the RX FIFO operates in store and forward mode (RSFL cleared).

field.name: PRODIS
field.description: Enable Discard Of Frames With Wrong Protocol Checksum

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Frames with wrong checksum are not discarded.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: If a TCP/IP, UDP/IP, or ICMP/IP frame is received that has a wrong TCP, UDP, or ICMP checksum, the frame is discarded. Discarding is only available when the RX FIFO operates in store and forward mode (RSFL cleared).

field.name: LINEDIS
field.description: Enable Discard Of Frames With MAC Layer Errors

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Frames with errors are not discarded.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: Any frame received with a CRC, length, or PHY error is automatically discarded and not forwarded to the user application interface.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: Instructs the MAC to write two additional bytes in front of each frame received into the RX FIFO.

register.name: RCMR%s
register.description: Receive Classification Match Register for Class n

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled (default): no compares will occur and the classification indicator for this class will never assert.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The register contents are valid and a comparison with all compare values is done when a VLAN frame is received.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: The DMA controller's channel for the class is not used. Disabling the DMA controller of a class also requires disabling the class match comparator for the class (see registers RCMRn). When class 1 and class 2 queues are disabled then their frames will be placed in queue 0.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: Enable the DMA controller to support the corresponding descriptor ring for this class of traffic.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: The traffic shaper function should consider 12 octets of IPG in addition to the frame data transferred for a frame when doing bandwidth calculations. This is the default.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: Addition of 12 bytes for the IPG should be omitted when calculating the bandwidth (for traffic shaping, when writing a frame into the transmit FIFO, the shaper will usually consider 12 bytes of IPG for every frame as part of the bandwidth allocated by the frame. This addition can be suppressed, meaning short frames will become more bandwidth than large frames due to the relation of data to IPG overhead).

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: The timer stops at the current value.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The timer starts incrementing.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Disable.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The timer can be reset to zero when the given offset time is reached (offset event). The field is cleared when the offset event is reached, so no further event occurs until the field is set again. The timer offset value must be set before setting this field.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: The timer is not affected and no action occurs, besides clearing OFFEN, when the offset is reached.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: If OFFEN is set, the timer resets to zero when the offset setting is reached. The offset event does not cause a timer interrupt.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Disable.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: A period event interrupt can be generated (EIR[TS_TIMER]) and the event signal output is asserted when the timer wraps around according to the periodic setting ATPER. The timer period value must be set before setting this bit. Not all devices contain the event signal output. See the chip configuration details.

field.name: PINPER

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Disable.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: Enable.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: No effect.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The current time is captured and can be read from the ATVR register.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: The timer is active and all configuration fields in this register are relevant.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The internal timer is disabled and the externally provided timer value is used. All other fields, except CAPTURE, in this register have no effect. CAPTURE can still be used to capture the current timer value.

enumeratedValue.name: INT_NOCLEAR
enumeratedValue.description: Do not clear the interrupt.

enumeratedValue.name: INT_CLEAR
enumeratedValue.description: Clear the IF field (interrupt flag).

enumeratedValue.name: INT_PEND
enumeratedValue.description: No interrupt is pending.

enumeratedValue.name: INT_NOPEND
enumeratedValue.description: An interrupt is pending.

enumeratedValue.name: DIS_INT
enumeratedValue.description: Disable interrupts to the system.

enumeratedValue.name: EN_INT
enumeratedValue.description: Enable interrupts to the system.

enumeratedValue.name: BC11
enumeratedValue.description: Compatible with BC1.1

enumeratedValue.name: BC12
enumeratedValue.description: Compatible with BC1.2 (default)

enumeratedValue.name: NO_START
enumeratedValue.description: Do not start the sequence. Writes of this value have no effect.

enumeratedValue.name: START
enumeratedValue.description: Initiate the charger detection sequence. If the sequence is already running, writes of this value have no effect.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_RESET
enumeratedValue.description: Do not perform a software reset.

enumeratedValue.name: SW_RESET
enumeratedValue.description: Perform a software reset.

field.name: CLOCK_UNIT
field.description: Unit of Measurement Encoding for Clock Speed

enumeratedValue.name: KHZ_CLK
enumeratedValue.description: kHz Speed (between 4 kHz and 1023 kHz)

enumeratedValue.name: MHZ_CLK
enumeratedValue.description: MHz Speed (between 1 MHz and 1023 MHz)

field.name: CLOCK_SPEED
field.description: Numerical Value of Clock Speed in Binary

enumeratedValue.name: NO_RESULT
enumeratedValue.description: No results to report.

enumeratedValue.name: CONN_SDP
enumeratedValue.description: Attached to an SDP. Must comply with USB 2.0 by drawing only 2.5 mA (max) until connected.

enumeratedValue.name: CONN_CP
enumeratedValue.description: Attached to a charging port. The exact meaning depends on the STATUS[SEQ_STAT] field (value 0: Attached to either a CDP or a DCP. The charger type detection has not completed. value 1: Attached to a CDP. The charger type detection has completed.)

enumeratedValue.name: CONN_DCP
enumeratedValue.description: Attached to a DCP.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_DATA_PIN_CONN
enumeratedValue.description: The module is either not enabled, or the module is enabled but the data pins have not yet been detected.

enumeratedValue.name: DATA_PIN_CONN
enumeratedValue.description: Data pin contact detection is complete.

enumeratedValue.name: CP_DET_DONE
enumeratedValue.description: Charging port detection is complete.

enumeratedValue.name: CT_DET_DONE
enumeratedValue.description: Charger type detection is complete.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_SEQ_ERR
enumeratedValue.description: No sequence errors.

enumeratedValue.name: SEQ_ERR
enumeratedValue.description: Error in the detection sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_TIMEOUT
enumeratedValue.description: The detection sequence is not running for over 1 s.

enumeratedValue.name: TIMEOUT
enumeratedValue.description: It is over 1 s since the data pin contact was detected and debounced.

enumeratedValue.name: SEQ_NOT_RUNNING
enumeratedValue.description: The sequence is not running.

enumeratedValue.name: SEQ_RUNNING
enumeratedValue.description: The sequence is running.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_OVERRIDE
enumeratedValue.description: No overrides. Field must remain at this value during normal USB data communication to prevent unexpected conditions on USB_DP and USB_DM pins. (Default)

enumeratedValue.name: PRI_DET_OVERRIDE
enumeratedValue.description: Enables VDP_SRC voltage source for the USB_DP pin and IDM_SINK current source for the USB_DM pin.

enumeratedValue.name: CDP_ADVERT
enumeratedValue.description: Enables VDM_SRC voltage source only.
